description: Processifier Process Mining is a process mining visual that streamlines the process of achieving actionable insights, making it a go-to tool for confident decision-making in Power BI without complex data integration projects, regardless of the data size. Explore our capabilities with the trial version and upgrade to the full version at your convenience. We also offer a feature-rich Power BI application for those interested in graph visualization and conformance checking, variant analysis, and advanced process discovery.
